title: The card of an own domain that starts with www. says to forward the bare name to it at the DNS provider
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/core/tracy-core/test/site-publish-dom.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the result of the case named in `run.tests`.
expect: S2: the case is 'ok': the card of `www.example.com` draws the line `bare-name` with `example.com` and `www.example.com`; the card of `shop.example.com` has no such line.
evidence: A site connects a subdomain only and nothing forwards the bare domain, so `example.com` opened nothing while `www.example.com` was live, and the screen did not say so.
fence: Tracy does not connect or forward a bare domain; whether the customer's DNS provider forwards it is not covered by this case.

tests: a domain that starts with www. says how its bare name reaches the site; any other subdomain says nothing
